name: yaml-schema-validator
description: Validates YAML config files against JSON Schema files written in YAML (sibling *.schema.yml or declared in the first line), with recursive 'extends' includes, diagnostics, completion and hover help. Compatible with the Red Hat YAML extension.

yamlSchema.extendKeyword.description: Mapping key that includes other YAML files (`extends: other.yml` or `extends: [a.yml, b.yml]`). The tag form uses the same word: `key: !extends other.yml`.

yamlSchema.schemaInfix.description: Middle part of schema file names: `name.yml` is validated by `name.<infix>.yml` in the same folder (default `name.schema.yml`). A file can also name its schema in its first line: `# schema: path/to/file.schema.yml`.

yamlSchema.unknownKeySeverity.description: Default severity for keys that are not allowed (`additionalProperties: false`); can be overridden per schema with `x-severity`.

yamlSchema.includeSummary.description: Show a summary diagnostic on each `extends` line when the included file (or anything it includes) has problems.

yamlSchema.unusedAnchors.description: Grey out anchors (`&name`) that no alias (`*name`) uses.

yamlSchema.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before revalidating after an edit or file change.

yamlSchema.exclude.description: Glob of files ignored when scanning the workspace for schema files and schema declarations.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --minify
